newsitem.title: FRANCE: French industry sees 1997 investment up 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: French industry sees 1997 investment up 4 pct.

text.p: French competitive-sector industry expects its investment, in real volume terms and historically adjusted for underestimation, to rise by four percent in 1997, a January survey of business leaders by national statistics institute INSEE showed.
They cut their expectations for the rise in investment in 1996 to one percent from the four percent they predicted in an October survey.
Investment in competitive industry represents only 30 percent of productive investment in France.
